files.empty: Claude hasn't edited or created any files in this conversation.

context.title: What fills the context
context.setupHint: System prompt, tools, MCP, memory files and skills: sent with every message
context.conversationHint: Your messages, Claude's replies and tool results
context.reserveHint: Kept free so Claude can summarize the conversation when it fills up
context.setupNote: Setup is the system prompt, tools, MCP, memory files and skills, sent with every message.
context.exactTitle: Runs /context in this tab (free) and reads Claude's exact numbers
context.adviceFull: Nearly full. Claude will soon summarize older messages on its own. Compact now to choose when, or start a new conversation for the next task.
context.adviceHalf: Over half full. Each message re-sends all of this, so long conversations get slower and cost more. Compact when you finish this task.
context.estimatedOpen: Estimated from the conversation. "Get exact numbers" runs Claude's free /context command in this tab.
context.estimatedPast: Estimated from the conversation. Continue it in a tab to get Claude's exact numbers.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.cacheNote: Re-reading from the cache costs about a tenth of sending it fresh, so a high number here is good.
tokens.warmUntil: The cache is warm until {{time}}: replying before then is cheaper.
tokens.warm: The cache is warm: replying before then is cheaper.
tokens.cold: The cache has gone cold; the next message re-reads the whole conversation.
